title: SessionOpenedEvent
description: An authenticated actor became present in the world at this tick. This is a world fact, not a transport log line: it opens a presence interval that SESSION_CLOSED closes, and the pair is the audit spine later used to answer 'was this character present when X happened'. It is deliberately NOT a Historical Event (importance level 0) - see docs/specs/p0-02-networking-spike.md section 6. actor_id is narrowed to non-null here: a session always has an authenticated actor.

actor_id.description: Narrowed from the envelope: never null for this type.

session_id.description: Session this event opens. Same value the client received in SESSION_READY.

transport.description: Transport the session was established on. A closed set today; a later transport (QUIC/WebTransport) adds a value, so consumers must tolerate unknown values.
